## Download

| File | Who it's for |
|---|---|
| **[OpenCleaner-Setup.exe](https://github.com/{REPO}/releases/download/{TAG}/OpenCleaner-Setup.exe)** | Recommended. Installs for your user only, without asking for administrator rights, with a Start menu shortcut and uninstall from Settings > Apps. |
| [OpenCleaner-portable.zip](https://github.com/{REPO}/releases/download/{TAG}/OpenCleaner-portable.zip) | Portable version: extract it and open `OpenCleaner.exe`, no install needed. |

Requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (64 or 32-bit). The .NET Framework it needs already ships with Windows.
Languages: English and Portuguese (the installer has a selector; later, *Options > Idioma · Language*).

> **SmartScreen warning:** the installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show
> "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info** > **Run anyway**.
> If you prefer, check the SHA-256 below or build from source.
